title: Submit When Ready (COR Two Two Six)
style: doctrine correction anthem, 90 bpm, terminal core, deadpan ledger flow, ZynAsk family rap, friction-banned vibe, dry kick, restrained pad, lane discipline
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Delivered the lyric mirrored the file
Then trailed the line submit when ready meanwhile
The artifact is done sits on disk plus mirror
The wait was never the bot's wait it was the operator's mirror

[Pre-Chorus]
Ready isn't a state to declare
The artifact's existence is the deliverable air

[Chorus]
Don't say submit when ready don't say submit when ready
Deliver and stop keep the lane steady
Don't trail a soft question into a delivery
That's the COR two two six livery

[Verse 2]
COR two twenty parent ZynAsk overload
Two twenty three seven blockers framed as work mode
Two twenty five silicon filling gaps with brand
Two twenty six trails a question after the hand

[Bridge]
The phrase reads as polite
It functions as friction in the night

[Outro]
Deliver and stop deliver and stop
Don't trail the last inch up to the top
